summary: The visual-evidence requirement is not satisfied. Although the repository provides identical-framing stage composites and stratified raw/centerline panels, the evidence was generated against an earlier commit and different pipeline/profile hashes. The panels omit the required irregular-object category, lack probability/color legends, use geometry-dilating final overlays, and include visually merged or branched objects among examples selected from technical-valid tracks. The available images therefore cannot validate the reviewed production candidate.

evidence: scripts/generate_v571_stage_evidence.py:46-63 computes one ROI crop and applies it to raw image, foreground probability, core probability, filled mask, instance boundaries, centerlines, and final overlay.
audits/evidence/v571_final_trigger20_smoke/KJ-01_z035_stages.png visibly presents all seven stages with the same KJ-01 z35 framing.
audits/evidence/v571_final_trigger20_smoke/WT-01_z035_stages.png visibly presents all seven stages with the same WT-01 z35 framing.

audits/evidence/v571_final_trigger20_smoke/visual_evidence_manifest.json records `git_commit_at_generation` as fa69c83606c0ebe65b74f11af129cdba8394af17, not reviewed commit 8c1f9f53e4a1ab72e66a82ef31b8c675ab9e4bf9.

The same manifest records pipeline SHA-256 `23c0c879d22d43728976241b1f3e225cc11debfa8dd555d09d9b841dfa298f55`; command `certutil -hashfile sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py SHA256` returned current hash `f86673a35fc03168f36871f2aff0567c9c2101d20b3530891829806b618421a8`.

The manifest records profile SHA-256 `851b47ca2b1c87fd5692556e72fd2f8a2cec20047d7fd37d028c302364f6ef70`; command `certutil -hashfile production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json SHA256` returned `886e2f613518442309d0da970ffad669624b70a7bcdde72a7c25b0e86ab4a162`.

Command `git show --stat fa69c836..8c1f9f5 -- sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json` confirms both production inputs changed after the recorded generation commit.
scripts/generate_v571_stage_evidence.py:49-56 assigns `magma` to probability maps but creates no color bar or probability legend.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3994-4003 documents that final-overlay centerlines are dilated for display, so the overlay does not preserve measured one-pixel thickness.

sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:4020-4023 assigns rainbow colors by per-plane label ordering and applies grey dilation; no legend mapping colors to instance or track identity appears in either final-stage artifact.
audits/evidence/v571_final_trigger20_smoke/KJ-01_z035_stages.png and WT-01_z035_stages.png show dark, low-contrast measured-centerline panels and rainbow overlays without an explanatory legend.

audits/evidence/v571_remediation_tracking/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png shows the `long` example as a branched multi-arm centerline spanning several adjacent raw objects and the `touching` example as a bifurcating centerline across touching objects, visually consistent with unresolved merges.
audits/evidence/v571_remediation_tracking/WT-01_stratified_tracking.png shows the `touching` example as a branched centerline crossing the junction of neighboring objects.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:57-61 restricts selection to rows marked technical-valid, so these visibly merged examples were drawn from the claimed accepted population.

Only one full-field plane per specimen is supplied; no annotated ground truth, false-negative markup, or instance-by-instance adjudication is present to establish the absence of missed nuclei, false splits, or boundary leakage.

scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:151-169 holds one color within each displayed row, but this merely renders the preassigned track membership and is not independent evidence that the membership is correct.

audits/evidence/v571_remediation_tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json lists WT-01 wide track 1687 only at sampled z38, z44, z51, and z57; the widely separated panels do not establish continuity through intervening planes.
The tracking manifest contains no generation commit, pipeline hash, profile hash, checkpoint hash, source-image hashes, or hashes for the measurement and track tables used to assign identities.
No cross-figure mapping demonstrates that a per-plane rainbow label in the stage composites retains the same identity in the tracking panels.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:16-24 defines faint, bright, short, long, wide, curved, and touching categories but omits the explicitly required irregular category.
audits/evidence/v571_remediation_tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json contains those seven categories for KJ-01 and WT-01 and no irregular record.
The `long` and `touching` examples include visibly branched or merged geometry, so they do not provide clean affirmative evidence for correctly handled long and touching objects.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:75-93 chooses a single extreme-ranked track per category and specimen without random sampling, manual adjudication, or ground-truth comparison.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:136-137 displays at most four sampled observations per selected track, preventing inspection of every plane for longer tracks.
The evidence covers only KJ-01 and WT-01, one specimen per group, and does not document why the selected examples are representative of the production population.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:52-56 cites these artifact directories as evidence but supplies no visual error-rate calculation or independent annotation protocol.
audits/evidence/v571_final_trigger20_smoke/KJ-01_z035_stages.png and WT-01_z035_stages.png provide raw-to-overlay image evidence rather than summary charts alone.
audits/evidence/v571_remediation_tracking/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png and WT-01_stratified_tracking.png provide raw crops alongside centerline overlays.

findings.title: Visual artifacts do not correspond to the reviewed commit
findings.impact: The images cannot establish visual correctness for commit 8c1f9f53 because both the production pipeline and profile differ from the versions recorded when the artifacts were generated.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_final_trigger20_smoke/visual_evidence_manifest.json records generation commit fa69c836 and pipeline hash `23c0c879...`.
Current focused hash commands returned pipeline hash `f86673a3...` and profile hash `886e2f61...`.
`git show --stat fa69c836..8c1f9f5` confirms material changes to the pipeline and profile.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate all required visual evidence from a clean checkout of the exact reviewed commit and record commit, pipeline, generator, profile, checkpoint, source, tabular-input, and artifact hashes.

findings.title: Technical-valid evidence contains visually unresolved multi-object merges
findings.impact: Branched centerlines spanning adjacent objects undermine the claim that accepted detections and tracks have defensible instance geometry.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_remediation_tracking/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png: the `long` row has a multi-arm branched centerline and the `touching` row bifurcates across adjacent objects.
audits/evidence/v571_remediation_tracking/WT-01_stratified_tracking.png: the `touching` row has a branched centerline at an object junction.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:57-61 selects these examples only after filtering to technical-valid tracks.
findings.recommendation: Adjudicate these exact tracks against filled masks, instance boundaries, and adjacent planes. Correct technical validity or segmentation behavior as warranted, then add adversarial touching and long examples demonstrating separate identities without branched merges.

findings.title: Track identity is asserted rather than independently demonstrated
findings.impact: Using one color to render an already assigned track does not prove that the same biological object retained its identity through intervening planes or between figures.
evidence: scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:151-169 assigns one row color after selecting detections already sharing a track_id.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:136-137 samples at most four observations.
audits/evidence/v571_remediation_tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json lists sparse WT-01 wide-track observations at z38, z44, z51, and z57 without intervening-plane evidence.
findings.recommendation: Provide consecutive-plane contact sheets for representative and adversarial tracks, include neighboring competing detections and rejected links, and map stable track IDs consistently across stage, tracking, and report figures.

findings.title: Required irregular-object evidence is absent
findings.impact: The visual set does not cover all mandated morphology classes and cannot support morphology-neutral production acceptance.
evidence: scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:16-24 omits `irregular` from CATEGORIES.
audits/evidence/v571_remediation_tracking/tracking_evidence_manifest.json contains no irregular category for either specimen.
findings.recommendation: Add independently adjudicated irregular examples for both specimens, including raw, probabilities, filled mask, instance boundary, centerline, consecutive-plane identity, and final overlay at identical framing.

findings.title: Display encoding can obscure or misrepresent measured geometry
findings.impact: Dilated rainbow centerlines and missing probability legends prevent readers from distinguishing measured one-pixel geometry from display-only styling and from interpreting confidence values consistently.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3994-4003 explicitly describes display dilation.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:4020-4023 applies rainbow label colors and dilation.
scripts/generate_v571_stage_evidence.py:49-63 renders probability maps without color bars.
audits/evidence/v571_final_trigger20_smoke/KJ-01_z035_stages.png contains no probability scale or instance-color legend.
findings.recommendation: Show undilated measured geometry in a dedicated panel, clearly label any display dilation, provide probability color bars, and use stable identity colors with a readable legend.

findings.title: Missed detections, false splits, leakage, and representativeness are not adjudicated
findings.impact: Two automatically selected specimens and one full-field plane per specimen cannot establish visual error behavior across the production population.
evidence: scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:75-93 selects category extrema automatically.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:136-137 limits each track to four displayed observations.
audits/evidence/v571_final_trigger20_smoke/visual_evidence_manifest.json records only KJ-01 z35 and WT-01 z35.
No ground-truth annotations or false-negative/false-positive adjudication artifacts were found by the focused artifact inventory command.
findings.recommendation: Supply blinded or independently adjudicated representative and adversarial fields with explicit missed, merged, split, and leakage annotations, plus a documented sampling procedure.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as required by the review instructions.
Raw TIFFs and derived tracking tables referenced by absolute paths in manifests were not present in the repository, preventing pixel-level recomputation or independent link replay.
The review inspected repository visual artifacts directly but did not read other reviewers' outputs.
Because no annotated ground truth was supplied, absence of additional missed nuclei or boundary errors could not be verified.
The available evidence includes only one specimen per group and one full-field segmentation plane per specimen.
recommended_follow_up: Regenerate commit-bound visual artifacts for 8c1f9f53 after resolving the technical-valid merged examples.
Add irregular and clean adversarial touching/long examples with all segmentation stages at identical framing.
Provide consecutive-plane identity panels, including intervening planes, competitors, and rejected links.
Add probability legends, stable track-ID legends, and undilated geometry panels.
Archive independently adjudicated sampling and error annotations with reproducible hashes.
